customer_notification_email_reconciliati.value: length("customer_notification_email_reconciliation"."evidence_reference") between 3 and 200 and length(btrim("customer_notification_email_reconciliation"."reason")) between 10 and 1000 and ("customer_notification_email_reconciliation"."provider_reference" is null or length("customer_notification_email_reconciliation"."provider_reference") between 1 and 128)

order_item_equivalent_offer_event_valid.name: order_item_equivalent_offer_event_valid

publication_correction_event_type_valid.name: publication_correction_event_type_valid
publication_correction_event_type_valid.value: ("publication_correction_event"."event_type" = 'OPENED' and "publication_correction_event"."publication_evidence_id" is null) or ("publication_correction_event"."event_type" = 'REVERIFIED' and "publication_correction_event"."publication_evidence_id" is not null)

supplier_item_notice_manual_sent_shape.name: supplier_item_notice_manual_sent_shape

supplier_item_notice_event_actor_valid.name: supplier_item_notice_event_actor_valid
supplier_item_notice_event_actor_valid.value: ("supplier_item_notice_event"."actor_kind" = 'STAFF' and "supplier_item_notice_event"."actor_user_id" is not null) or ("supplier_item_notice_event"."actor_kind" = 'PROVIDER' and "supplier_item_notice_event"."actor_user_id" is null)
